name: Kiss in the Storm: A Risk of Rain Fangame
source:
Kiss in the Storm is an adult visual novel set in the Risk of Rain 2 universe. After a little over two years in development - most of that spent writing - I'm proud to finally present this project for your enjoyment! The Risk of Rain universe has been massively inspiring to me, and in many ways this is a love letter to the project as a whole. In Kiss in the Storm:

    Explore an alternate timeline of the game's events, expanding on the lore of the RoR universe!
    Meet the monsters, date them... and maybe take it a step further?
    Meet eldritch deities beyond your comprehension (and date them too!) (Go further at your own risk.)

Featuring guest art from @schmeato_ and @Spicemanart on Twitter, as well as an absolutely boppin' soundtrack from a bunch of wonderful musicians! Check out the audio panel on Newgrounds for links!

Content Warnings:

    Violence and death
    Explicit sexual scenes

Kiss in the Storm is unaffiliated with Hopoo Games. This fan project is not for profit and does not claim to own any rights to Risk of Rain, the source material. 

[from itch.io]
translation:
《Kiss in the Storm》是一部設定在《雨中冒險2》世界觀下的成人視覺小說。歷經兩年多的開發——其中大部分時間都花在劇本寫作上——我很自豪終於能將這部作品呈現給大家！《雨中冒險》的世界觀給予了我莫大的靈感，從很多方面來說，這也是獻給原作的一封情書。在《Kiss in the Storm》中：

    探索遊戲事件的平行時間線，拓展《雨中冒險》宇宙的背景設定！
    結識怪物們，與它們約會……甚至還可以更進一步？
    邂逅超乎你理解範疇的詭秘神明（並且也可以和祂們約會！）（若要更進一步，後果自負。）

本作包含來自Twitter畫師@schmeato_與@Spicemanart的客座插畫，以及由一眾優秀音樂人打造的超有感的遊戲配樂！相關連結請檢視Newgrounds上的音訊面板！

內容警告：

    暴力與死亡
    露骨的性愛場景

《Kiss in the Storm》與Hopoo Games沒有任何隸屬關係。本同人企劃為非營利性質，不對原作《雨中冒險》主張任何權利。
